patent.title: Road-building machine
patent.family_note: Claim-focused Rights Control replication in industrial road-milling machinery. Claim 29 survived the 2019 IPR challenge used here.

knowledge_origin.description: This replication does not reconstruct the full original R&D genealogy.

technology.problem: Improve stability of a road-building/road-milling machine over uneven surfaces using hydraulically coupled height-adjustable supports.
technology.mechanism: Claim 29 depends from a road-building-machine claim and adds a four-sided stability pattern relative to the working roller/rotor footprint.

value_carriers.name: Caterpillar commercial road-milling machines covered in ITC 337-TA-1067
value_carriers.description: PTAB records the ITC finding that Caterpillar's PM620 infringed claim 29, and the ITC issued an LEO covering infringing road-milling machines/components.

value_links.note: Commercial machine infringement mapping; no claim-specific monetary amount.

value_metrics.value: ITC limited exclusion order covering infringing Caterpillar road-milling machines and components

gaps.description: The public ITC/IPR record does not apportion product economics or a monetary amount specifically to US7828309 claim 29.
V0.7 cannot encode that PTAB failed to establish claim 29 unpatentable while an ITC exclusion remedy was operating; these are claim-set Rights Control facts separate from R4.

notes: Rights Control replication Pair 4, stronger-rights side. R4 is based on adjudicated commercial implementation plus an exclusion remedy; no claim-specific money is inferred.

patent.title: Milling machine with re-entering back wheels
patent.family_note: Claim-focused Rights Control replication in the same industrial road-milling market. At T0, claim 19 had an adverse PTAB FWD but no cancellation certificate, while the ITC LEO remained operative.

knowledge_origin.description: This replication does not reconstruct the full original R&D genealogy or historical assignments.

technology.problem: Move a rear wheel/track of a road milling machine between projecting and retracted positions to enable flush milling while maintaining steering/control.
technology.mechanism: Claim 19 concerns a road-construction/milling-machine articulation arrangement used in machines with re-entering rear wheel/track geometry.

value_carriers.name: Wirtgen Series 1810 road-milling machines covered in ITC 337-TA-1088
value_carriers.description: CBP records the Commission finding that Series 1810 machines infringed claim 19 and the resulting limited exclusion order.

value_links.note: Commercial machine infringement mapping; no claim-specific monetary amount.

value_metrics.value: ITC limited exclusion order remained in effect; CBP excluded multiple Wirtgen cold-milling machines

gaps.description: The ITC/CBP record does not apportion a monetary value specifically to US7140693 claim 19.
V0.7 cannot encode the split T0 state: PTAB had found claim 19 unpatentable, yet no cancellation certificate had issued and the ITC exclusion order remained operative.

notes: Rights Control replication Pair 4, adverse-but-operative side. The T0 state must not be collapsed to a simple valid/invalid boolean.
